async def act(page):
    """
    Continue from the current New Product page (already showing Name = "Lelelumon Yoga Mat").
    Complete required fields and save product with:
      - Price: 769.99 (Prices tab)
      - Description and Short Description
      - SKU: LEL-YM-001
      - Weight: 1
      - Status: Enabled
      - Inventory: Qty = 42, Stock Availability = In Stock
      - Custom Options: Size -> uni-size; Color -> black

    Notes:
    - Use only accessibility-centric selectors (.get_by_role, .get_by_label, .select_option).
    - No knowledge_base helper functions are available in the environment; none are used.
    - Save is the last action because it navigates away.
    """
    import asyncio

    # Helper wrappers that only use accessibility APIs
    async def try_fill_labels(labels, value, index=0, timeout=1500):
        """Try multiple label texts (substring match). Returns True if any succeeded."""
        for lbl in labels:
            try:
                locator = page.get_by_label(lbl).nth(index)
                await locator.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=timeout)
                await locator.fill(value)
                return True
            except Exception:
                continue
        return False

    async def try_select_combobox(names, option_label, timeout=1500):
        """Try selecting option_label in comboboxes matching any of names."""
        for name in names:
            try:
                cb = page.get_by_role("combobox", name=name).first
                await cb.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=timeout)
                await cb.select_option(label=option_label)
                return True
            except Exception:
                continue
        # fallback: try any combobox
        try:
            cb_any = page.get_by_role("combobox").first
            await cb_any.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=timeout)
            await cb_any.select_option(label=option_label)
            return True
        except Exception:
            return False

    async def try_click_role(role, names, timeout=1500):
        """Try clicking an element role with any of the given name substrings."""
        for name in names:
            try:
                el = page.get_by_role(role, name=name).first
                await el.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=timeout)
                await el.click()
                return True
            except Exception:
                continue
        return False

    # Give the current page a moment to settle
    await asyncio.sleep(0.5)

    # 1) Fill required General fields visible on this page
    await try_fill_labels(["Description *", "Description"], "High quality Lelelumon yoga mat for daily practice.")
    await try_fill_labels(["Short Description *", "Short Description"], "Lightweight, durable yoga mat.")
    await try_fill_labels(["SKU *", "SKU"], "LEL-YM-001")
    await try_fill_labels(["Weight *", "Weight"], "1")

    # Set Status -> Enabled
    await try_select_combobox(["Status *", "Status"], "Enabled")

    # 2) Prices tab -> set Price to 769.99
    # Click the Prices link in the left Product Information nav (use link role)
    await try_click_role("link", ["Prices"])  # substring match
    await asyncio.sleep(0.4)
    # Fill Price; try common labels
    await try_fill_labels(["Price *", "Price"], "769.99")

    # 3) Inventory tab -> set Qty = 42 and Stock Availability = In Stock
    await try_click_role("link", ["Inventory"])  # substring match
    await asyncio.sleep(0.4)
    await try_fill_labels(["Qty", "Qty *", "Quantity", "Quantity *"], "42")
    await try_select_combobox(["Stock Availability", "Stock Availability *", "Stock Status"], "In Stock")

    # 4) Custom Options tab: add Size and Color drop-down options
    await try_click_role("link", ["Custom Options"])  # substring match
    await asyncio.sleep(0.5)

    # Helper to add a single drop-down custom option
    async def add_custom_dropdown_option(option_title, option_value):
        # Click Add New Option button
        added = await try_click_role("button", ["Add New Option", "Add New", "Add Option"]) 
        if not added:
            return False
        await asyncio.sleep(0.3)

        # Fill the newest Title input. Try several Title label indices to find the newly added one.
        filled_title = False
        for idx in range(0, 6):
            try:
                t = page.get_by_label("Title").nth(idx)
                await t.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=800)
                await t.fill(option_title)
                filled_title = True
                break
            except Exception:
                continue

        # Set Input Type / Type to Drop-down
        await try_select_combobox(["Input Type", "Type"], "Drop-down")

        # Add New Row for the option value
        await try_click_role("button", ["Add New Row", "Add Row"]) 
        await asyncio.sleep(0.2)

        # Fill the value Title for the newly added row. Find a Title input that doesn't match option_title.
        filled_value = False
        for idx in range(0, 10):
            try:
                v = page.get_by_label("Title").nth(idx)
                await v.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=600)
                # If this input already contains the option_title, skip it
                try:
                    current = await v.input_value()
                except Exception:
                    current = ""
                if option_title.lower() in (current or "").lower():
                    continue
                await v.fill(option_value)
                filled_value = True
                break
            except Exception:
                continue

        return filled_title and filled_value

    # Add Size -> uni-size
    await add_custom_dropdown_option("Size", "uni-size")
    await asyncio.sleep(0.2)
    # Add Color -> black
    await add_custom_dropdown_option("Color", "black")

    # 5) Final action: Save the product (make this the last action)
    # Prefer the explicit Save button
    try:
        await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save").first.click()
    except Exception:
        # fallback to Save and Continue Edit
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save and Continue Edit").first.click()
        except Exception:
            # last resort: click the first visible button
            try:
                await page.get_by_role("button").first.click()
            except Exception:
                pass

    # wait for the save/navigation to complete
    await asyncio.sleep(1)

        # Click Add New Option button
        added = await try_click_role("button", ["Add New Option", "Add New", "Add Option"])
        if not added:
            return False
        await asyncio.sleep(0.3)

        # Fill the newest Title input. Try several Title label indices to find the newly added one.
        filled_title = False
        for idx in range(0, 6):
            try:
                t = page.get_by_label("Title").nth(idx)
                await t.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=800)
                await t.fill(option_title)
                filled_title = True
                break
            except Exception:
                continue

        # Set Input Type / Type to Drop-down
        await try_select_combobox(["Input Type", "Type"], "Drop-down")

        # Add New Row for the option value
        await try_click_role("button", ["Add New Row", "Add Row"])
        await asyncio.sleep(0.2)

        # Fill the value Title for the newly added row. Find a Title input that doesn't match option_title.
        filled_value = False
        for idx in range(0, 10):
            try:
                v = page.get_by_label("Title").nth(idx)
                await v.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=600)
                # If this input already contains the option_title, skip it
                try:
                    current = await v.input_value()
                except Exception:
                    current = ""
                if option_title.lower() in (current or "").lower():
                    continue
                await v.fill(option_value)
                filled_value = True
                break
            except Exception:
                continue

        return filled_title and filled_value

    # Add Size -> uni-size
    await add_custom_dropdown_option("Size", "uni-size")
    await asyncio.sleep(0.2)
    # Add Color -> black
    await add_custom_dropdown_option("Color", "black")

    # 5) Final action: Save the product (make this the last action)
    # Prefer the explicit Save button
    try:
        await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save").first.click()
    except Exception:
        # fallback to Save and Continue Edit
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save and Continue Edit").first.click()
        except Exception:
            # last resort: click the first visible button
            try:
                await page.get_by_role("button").first.click()
            except Exception:
                pass

    # wait for the save/navigation to complete
    await asyncio.sleep(1)
